description: Source code implementing patch ID management for git commits, including functions for initializing, comparing, iterating, and adding patch IDs.

methods.name: patch_id_defined
methods.description: Checks if a commit has 0 or 1 parents, indicating if patch ID can be generated.

methods.name: commit_patch_id
methods.description: Generates a patch ID for a commit, using diff options.

methods.name: patch_id_neq
methods.description: Compares two patch IDs for inequality, loading full patch IDs if necessary.

methods.name: init_patch_ids
methods.description: Initializes patch ID management for a repository.

methods.name: free_patch_ids
methods.description: Frees resources associated with patch ID management.

methods.name: init_patch_id_entry
methods.description: Initializes a patch_id structure with commit data.

methods.name: patch_id_iter_first
methods.description: Returns the first patch_id for a commit, if defined.

methods.name: patch_id_iter_next
methods.description: Returns the next patch_id in iteration.

methods.name: has_commit_patch_id
methods.description: Checks if a commit has an associated patch ID.

methods.name: add_commit_patch_id
methods.description: Adds a new patch ID for a commit to the patch ID set.
